note_placeholder: What happened? How did it feel?

recording_too_large: That recording is too large to store. Up to 10 MB.
video_unsupported: Video recording isn't supported in this browser.
video_too_long: A video note is up to 30 seconds. Pick a shorter one, or record it here.
video_too_large: That video is too large to store, and it couldn’t be made smaller.
gender_hint: However it feels right now. There are no wrong answers.
quick_log_dims_hint: Skipping keeps the mood entry exactly as saved.
body_map_hint: Optional. Pick a spot on the body, then set dysphoria, euphoria, or both.
body_map_chart_aria: Two lines for {region}: {first} and {second}, over the chosen range.
body_region_inspector_sub: somatic breakdown across feelings, measurements, photos, and procedures
body_region_empty_title: No records for this area yet
body_region_empty_body: Log an entry, measurement, or treatment for this region to track somatic changes over time.
body_region_measurements_empty: No measurements recorded for this zone yet.
body_region_photos_empty: No photos tagged with this region yet.
body_region_hair_removal_empty: No hair removal sessions for this zone yet.
body_region_trajectory_empty: No feelings logged for this region yet.

trash_empty_body: A deleted entry shows up here for 30 days before it's gone for good.
trash_read_failed_body: This is not the same as an empty trash. Nothing was deleted by the failure, so whatever was waiting here is still waiting. Leave the screen and come back to try again.
backup_stale_title: Your last backup was {days} days ago
backup_stale_body: Your journal lives only on this device.
empty_home_title: Your story starts with one entry
empty_home_body: Log how today felt. A mood is enough, and you can add more later.
home_milestones_empty_body: Add a coming-out date, a start date, or anything else worth marking.
metric_note: The same colour choice drives the calendar heat-map.
heat_hint: Days with entries are filled in: deeper colour means a higher {metric}. Days with several entries show the day’s average. Tap a filled day to see its entries.
add_another_entry: Add another entry for this day
nothing_logged_body: You can still add an entry for it. Memory counts.
search_hint: Notes and tags, with or without diacritics. “lozko” finds “łóżko”.
no_results_body: No entries match “{query}”. Try a shorter word: prefixes match too.
search_no_results_filtered: No entries match these filters yet.
starred_shelf_empty_body: Star an entry or a photo to keep it here.
not_enough_data: Not enough data in this range yet.
insights_note: Observations, not conclusions. Tags with fewer than 3 entries in range are hidden.
insights_empty: Not enough tagged entries in this range yet.
correlation_cards_empty: Not enough logged data yet to show a pattern.
interval_mood_sub: Where your days have tended to fall across the dosing interval
interval_mood_empty: Not enough logged data yet to show a pattern.
interval_mood_chart_aria: Mood by day of interval, {count} points, day {from} to day {to}.
custom_interval_title: Mood by a custom interval length
custom_interval_sub: Folds your mood history by any interval length you name. That doesn't mean a cycle exists.
custom_interval_empty: Not enough logged data yet to show a pattern.
custom_interval_chart_aria: Mood folded by a {days}-day interval, {count} points, day {from} to day {to}.
body_map_sub: track one spot's dysphoria and euphoria over time
care_rail_empty: Nothing to put on the line yet. A regimen, a logged dose or a lab result draws the first mark.
care_regimen_several: More than one regimen is running
care_mark_off_rail_aria: {what}, {when}, outside the range this line shows
a11y_legibility_boost_sub: stronger secondary text and clearer separators
a11y_motion_reduce_override_sub: keeps animations reduced even if the system allows motion
scales_note: Whatever you tick is what the entry screen offers. Unticking one never loses what it already holds.
custom_dimension_sub: your own words at both ends
tag_groups_sub: choose which groups appear on entries
body_measurements_sub: waist, hips, chest and underbust over time
settings_measurement_unit_sub: what body measurement charts convert every reading to
size_log_sub: what you bought, the size, and how it fit
cycle_tracking_toggle_sub: Show cycle tracking in More and on the side effects screen. For tracking a cycle when no testosterone regimen is active.
cycle_tracking_regimen_row_sub: Log bleeding and spotting against this regimen.
cycle_events_open_row_sub: Every event, and the chart against the regimen.
dim_euphoria_dysphoria_note: Where the day sat between dysphoria and euphoria.
dim_femininity_note: How feminine the day felt, from not at all to very.
dim_masculinity_note: How masculine the day felt, from not at all to very.
dim_binary_nonbinary_note: Where the day sat between binary and nonbinary.
dim_agender_gendered_note: Where the day sat between agender and a strong sense of gender.
tagdesc_dt_physical: Discomfort with your body's shape or sex characteristics.
tagdesc_dt_biochemical: A mismatch between the hormones your body produces and what your brain expects.
tagdesc_dt_social: Discomfort with how other people perceive you and address you.
tagdesc_dt_societal: Discomfort with gendered roles and expectations built into society, not any one interaction.
tagdesc_dt_sexual: Discomfort with sexual roles or expectations that don't fit how you experience your gender.
tagdesc_dt_presentational: Discomfort with how you present, or are made to present, through clothing, hair and other visible choices.
tagdesc_dt_existential: Grief over experiences and milestones missed while growing up as a gender that wasn't yours.
prompt_dysphoria_moment: Did anything today feel dysphoric? What was it?
prompt_body_feeling: How did your body feel today?
prompt_seen_moment: Was there a moment today you felt truly seen?
prompt_self_care: What's one small thing you did for yourself today?
prompt_presentation_feeling: How did you feel about how you presented today?
prompt_name_pronouns_feeling: How did it feel to hear your name and pronouns today?
prompt_proud_moment: What's something about today you're proud of?
scale_not_ticked: Not ticked any more, kept from this entry
empty_entry: Add a mood, a value, a tag, a note or a photo first
ob_welcome_def: en·gen·der /ɪnˈdʒendə(r)/ v.: to bring into being.
ob_welcome_body: A diary for moods, gender feelings, tags and photos. A bad day can make everything look worse than it is. Your entries remember how it really was. All of it stays on this device. No account, no cloud, no tracking.
ob_name_title: What should the app call you?
ob_name_body: Only used to greet you. It never leaves this device, and you can skip it.
ob_flag_body: It colours the whole app, and the sun in the corner is drawn from its own stripes. Change it any time in Settings.
ob_track_title: How do you want to track gender?
ob_track_body: Tick the scales you want when you log. You can change this any time in Settings.
ob_lock_body: The app can lock itself the moment it goes to the background, so a glance at your phone in a pocket or on a desk shows nothing. Getting back in asks for whatever opens your journal. You chose that a moment ago and can change it in Settings.
ob_checkin_body: One notification asking how today was, skipped on days you have already written. Off is fine too, and the same switch is in Settings.
ob_done_body: One short entry a day is plenty. Everything you write stays here, with you.
pin_confirm_body: The same four digits again, so a slip of the thumb doesn’t lock you out.
pin_mismatch: Those two did not match. Start again.
pin_throttled: Too many wrong tries. Try again in {seconds}s.
pin_forgot_no_recovery: There is no way to recover it
reset_offer: You can start over instead. That deletes every entry, photo and setting on this device and takes you back to the welcome screen. If you have an archive from an earlier export, you can restore from it afterwards.
reset_offer_archive_password: You can start over instead. That deletes every entry, photo and setting on this device and takes you back to the welcome screen. If you have an archive from an earlier export, you can restore from it afterwards with that archive’s own password.
reset_failed: Could not reset the app. Try again, or close and reopen it first.
lock_auto_note: Locks automatically when the app goes to background.
pp_setup_body: This passphrase becomes the portable secret for this journal. After the session ends, you will need it to open the journal again. Save it in a password manager now: enGender has no account behind it and cannot recover the passphrase or the journal if it is lost.
pp_unlock_body: Enter your journal passphrase to decrypt your journal.
pp_forgot_no_recovery: There is no way to recover it
pp_forgot_key_note: The journal is encrypted with a key only your passphrase can unwrap. Nobody, including this app, can read it back without one or the other.
pp_convert_setup_body: Your journal is on this device but it is not encrypted yet. Choosing a passphrase now encrypts every entry, photo and setting already in it, and from then on this passphrase is the only thing that opens them. Save it in a password manager before you continue: enGender has no account behind it and cannot recover the passphrase or the journal if it is lost.
pp_convert_resume_body: Encrypting your journal was interrupted. Enter the passphrase you chose and it will carry on from where it stopped. Everything you had written is still here.
pp_converting_note: This can take a while on a big journal. If it stops, opening enGender again picks up where it left off.
pp_converting_database: Copying your journal into encrypted storage…
pp_convert_refused_space: Encrypting your journal means writing a second copy of it before the first one goes, and there is not enough room on this device: it needs about {need} free and has {free}. Free some space and open enGender again. Nothing has been changed.
pp_convert_refused_schema: This journal was last opened by a newer version of enGender, and this one would not understand all of it. Update the app, then open it again. Nothing has been changed.
pp_add_body: Right now this journal is tied to this browser or device. Adding a passphrase wraps the same journal key under a portable secret, so the journal itself is not rewritten. After that, you will need the passphrase to open this journal after the session ends.
pp_change_body: The passphrase wraps the key your journal is encrypted with, so changing it takes effect immediately and nothing is re-encrypted. The old passphrase stops working everywhere, including for this device’s unlock screen. enGender cannot recover a lost passphrase, so save the new one in a password manager before you change it.
pp_change_mismatch: The new passphrase and its confirmation did not match.
pp_added_toast: Passphrase added. Save it in your password manager.
dbr_title: This journal was tied to this device
dbr_body: This journal was opened without a journal passphrase, and the local key this browser or device kept for it is no longer available. enGender cannot recover that key, so this copy cannot be reopened.
pp_change_wrong_current: The current passphrase is not right.
pp_changed_toast: Passphrase changed. Update it in your password manager too.
ak_unlock_body: Your journal is encrypted. Android is holding the key and hands it over once it knows it is you.
ak_prompt_subtitle: Unlock to decrypt what you have written.
ak_locked_out: Too many tries. The sensor will not take another one for a while, but your device PIN still will.
ak_unavailable: This device has no fingerprint or face check that enGender can use.
ak_unenrolled: There is no fingerprint or face set up on this device.
ak_no_lock_body: Your journal’s key lives in Android’s key store, and Android will not hold a key on a device with no screen lock. Set a PIN, pattern or password in the device settings, then come back here.
ak_forgot_key_note: The journal is encrypted with a key Android holds for you and unwraps for nobody else. Without it, nothing can read the journal back, this app included.
ak_invalidated_body: Android destroys the key it was holding for you when a device’s screen lock is removed, and there is no way to bring it back. Your entries are still on this phone and nothing can open them any more. If you have an archive from an earlier export, you can start over and restore from it.
ak_plaintext_journal: This phone still has a journal from before Android encryption. Install the conversion build first, then come back to this one.
boot_no_persistent_storage: This browser didn’t grant persistent storage. Export backups regularly so nothing is lost to storage pressure.
update_ready_body: Switching to it reloads the app. Nothing you have written is lost, and there is no hurry.
boot_schema_too_new_title: Your journal is newer than this version
boot_schema_too_new_body: A newer version of enGender has already opened this journal, and this build would not understand all of it, so it has not touched it. Nothing has been changed and nothing is lost. What opens it again is that newer version, and the button below goes and looks for it.
boot_schema_too_new_still_old: Still nothing newer on offer here. Your journal is untouched, so this is worth trying again later.
boot_restore_offer: Your journal from before this update is still on this device. Putting it back replaces what the update left half finished, so anything the app has written since the copy was taken goes with it, and that cannot be undone. If this version still cannot open the restored journal, the version you had before can.
boot_restore_failed: That did not work. The copy is still on the device.
exp_last_backup_never: never, so your journal exists only on this device
exp_encrypted_body: Everything, including entries, photos, milestones, tags, your own scales, lab results and settings, packed into one file and encrypted before it leaves the app.
exp_crypto_note: AES-256-GCM, key derived with Argon2id. Without the password the file is unreadable, including to the person who wrote this app.
exp_cancelled: Export cancelled. Nothing left the app.
exp_failed: The export could not be finished. Nothing was saved.
exp_auto_sub: encrypted backup to a folder you pick
exp_auto_note: Folder: {folder}. Backups are encrypted with your export password, and that password is never stored.
exp_auto_destination_note: Any folder works, including one from a cloud provider such as Google Drive or Dropbox. Only the encrypted backup ever reaches it, never your journal in the clear or that provider's account details.
exp_auto_password_saved: Export password is saved securely on this device for scheduled backups.
exp_auto_password_missing: No password saved yet for scheduled backups.
exp_auto_reselect_needed: Backup folder access was lost. Pick a folder again.
imp_password_placeholder: The password it was exported with
imp_merge_note: Anything the backup has and this device doesn’t is added. Nothing you already logged is changed.
imp_replace_note: Everything in this journal is discarded and the backup takes its place. Your PIN, app lock and disguise settings stay as they are.
imp_password_needed: Type the password this backup was made with.
imp_replaced_toast: Restored. This journal is the backup now.
imp_merged_toast: Merged in. Nothing you already had was touched.
imp_wrong_password: That password doesn’t unlock this file. Passwords are case-sensitive, so check and try again. Nothing was imported.
imp_not_an_archive: This isn’t an enGender backup file. Nothing was imported.
imp_newer_version: This backup was made by a newer version of the app. Update first, then import it. Nothing was imported.
imp_corrupt: This file is damaged and can’t be read to the end. Nothing was imported; your journal is exactly as it was.
imp_failed: The import couldn’t be finished. Your journal is exactly as it was.
verify_ok_toast: This backup opens and reads back cleanly. Nothing on this device was touched.
verify_wrong_password: That password doesn’t unlock this file. Passwords are case-sensitive, so check and try again.
verify_not_an_archive: This isn’t an enGender backup file.
verify_newer_version: This backup was made by a newer version of the app. Update first, then check it again.
verify_corrupt: This file is damaged and can’t be read to the end.
plain_body: For spreadsheets and portability: CSV (flat) or JSON (full structure).
exp_warning_title: There’s no way to recover a forgotten password
exp_warning_body: If you forget this password, the archive is unreadable forever, including to the person who wrote this app. There is no recovery option, no exceptions.
plain_notice_body: Anyone who gets it can read your whole journal. Store it somewhere only you can reach, or use the encrypted export instead.
daylio_row_sub: moods, activities and notes, always a merge
daylio_unmapped: These mood labels aren’t mapped: {labels}. Nothing has been imported. Rename them in Daylio to a default English or Polish mood, export again, and retry.
daylio_unreadable: This CSV couldn’t be read. Nothing has been imported.
daylio_failed: The Daylio import couldn’t be finished. Your journal is exactly as it was.
daylio_always_merge: This import is always a merge. Nothing you already logged is changed.
mood_colours_note: Kept separate from the palette above, so a mood dot never looks like a gender colour.
security_intro: How your journal opens is the one thing standing between your entries and anyone who gets hold of this device. Without that secret nobody gets back in, the app included. Lock on leave uses the same secret, so it asks for it again rather than for anything weaker.
bio_row_sub: faster unlock with a fingerprint or face
bio_row_needs_surface: applies while your screen lock opens the journal
bio_ask_boot_body: Your device's own lock opens your journal every time the app starts, whichever lock that is for you. Saying yes opens it the moment you arrive. Saying no leaves the same lock behind a button you tap first.
about_license: Free software under the GPLv3 license. The source code is public.
about_no_network_title: This app makes no network requests.
about_no_network_body: No account, no cloud, no telemetry, no analytics. Your journal exists only on this device and in backups you export yourself.
disguise_app_sub_android: the launcher icon and name become a neutral “Notes”, and the app closes briefly to switch
disguise_app_sub_web: the browser tab shows a neutral “Notes” title and icon, and the app installs under that name
disguise_preview_android: how the app appears in your launcher
disguise_installed_note: If you have already installed this app, the name and icon on your home screen change when your browser next refreshes them. Browsers do that on their own schedule, so it may take a while.
decoy_note_groceries_body: milk, eggs, oats, coffee, something for dinner
decoy_note_todo_body: pick up the parcel, water the plants, call the dentist

ms_intro: Days that matter. Past ones come back as anniversaries, and future ones count down on Home.
ms_delete_hint: Its photo is removed too. This cannot be undone.
tags_intro: Built-in tags can be hidden and their history stays. Your own tags can be renamed or deleted.
tags_delete_hint: This removes the tag from every entry that uses it. The entries themselves are untouched. This cannot be undone.

affirmations_custom_empty: No custom lines yet for this language.

body_regions_intro: Built-in regions can be hidden - past entries and their charts stay. A region you add is listed here rather than placed on the body map.
cd_intro: Track anything the built-in scales miss. You choose the words for both ends.
cd_preview_note: This is how it will look on the entry screen.
labs_intro: Your numbers, your trend. The app never interprets them and gives no medical advice.
labs_too_little: Two results make a trend. Add another when it comes in.
labs_empty_body: Add bloodwork as it comes in and watch your own trend over time. No ranges, no grades, just your numbers.
labs_new_unit_toast: {unit} is new for {analyte}, so it gets its own trend.
labs_no_unit_toast: This result has no unit, so it gets its own trend.
labs_ocr_pick_intro: Pick a photo from gallery or camera. OCR runs on this device.
labs_ocr_download_body: That is the reading engine and its two languages. After that the scanner works with no network.
labs_ocr_permission_denied: Camera or gallery permission was denied. Grant access and try again.
labs_ocr_no_rows_body: OCR found no usable lab rows. Add manually or try another photo.
labs_ocr_review_intro: Check every row before saving. You can edit analyte, value, unit, date and note.
labs_ocr_low_confidence: Low confidence: please double-check this row.
labs_ocr_missing_analyte: Every included row needs an analyte.
labs_ocr_invalid_value: Every included row needs a valid numeric value.
labs_ocr_missing_date: Every included row needs a date before save.
labs_ocr_invalid_date: One of the included dates is invalid.
labs_ocr_failed: OCR import failed. Try another photo.
labs_preferred_units_intro: Pick one default unit per analyte. Existing results stay as logged.
measurements_intro: Your own numbers, in whatever unit you measure in. No BMI, no guesses about body composition.
measurement_too_little: Two measurements make a trend. Add another when you have one.
measurement_empty_body: Log a measurement and watch your own trend over time.
measurement_protocol_waist: Measure at the narrowest point, usually just above the navel. Same time of day and similar tension on the tape make measurements easier to compare, though neither is required.
measurement_protocol_hips: Measure around the widest part of the hips and buttocks, with the tape level all the way round.
measurement_protocol_chest: Measure around the fullest part of the chest or bust, with the tape level and not pulled tight.
measurement_protocol_underbust: Measure directly under the bust, where a bra band sits, with the tape snug but not compressing.
measurement_manage_types_intro: Add your own, or hide one you don't use. Hiding keeps everything already logged against it.
size_log_intro: What you bought, and how it fit.
size_log_row_aria: Edit the size logged for {category} on {date}
size_log_empty_body: Log a size whenever you buy something: category, size, brand and how it fit.
size_log_fit_note_placeholder: e.g. runs small, true to size
labs_context_none: No dosing context was recorded for this draw.
labs_context_needs_time: An hours-since-dose figure needs the draw time. Day-of-interval, for injections, does not.
labs_context_frozen: Recorded when this result was saved, from the dose log as it stood then. Editing a dose later does not change it.
labs_mixed_body: These readings were not all taken under the same conditions:
labs_mixed_position: different points in the dosing interval
regimen_row_sub: What you're taking, and since when
regimen_intro: What you're taking, at what dose and by what route, as it's changed over time. Every entry, photo and lab result is attributed to whichever episode was in effect when it was logged.
regimen_empty_body: Add your current regimen, then log a new episode whenever it changes.
regimen_drug_placeholder: e.g. estradiol valerate or testosterone cypionate
regimen_end_hint: Leave blank while it's still ongoing. Two episodes for different drugs can be active at once, so ending this one doesn't touch the other.
doses_row_sub: Every dose, and how it sits against the schedule
doses_intro: Each dose is filed under whichever regimen episode was in effect when it was taken. Correct a dose's date and it moves to the episode that really covered it.
doses_empty_body: Log a dose and it shows up here, under the regimen episode that was in effect that day.
doses_no_episode: No regimen episode covers this date
doses_ambiguous_episode: More than one regimen was active: drug not recorded
dose_site_recency_aria: Days since each site was last used
dose_time_hint: The time of day is kept, not just the date. Later screens work out how long ago a dose was.
dose_drug_hint: More than one regimen is active right now, so this app can't tell them apart on its own.
dose_injection_site_hint: Tap where it went. The map marks where the last one went, so you can see what to rotate to.
dose_scheduled_hint: Kept beside what you actually took, so the two can be read side by side later.
adherence_no_episode: There is no regimen episode yet, so there is no schedule to compare against.
adherence_multiple_episodes: More than one regimen is active at once. This screen compares doses against a single episode's schedule, and does not yet support more than one at a time.
adherence_no_schedule: {drug} has no schedule yet. Add one on the regimen screen and the expected doses show up here.
adherence_for_episode: Expected doses for {drug}, counted from its start date.
adherence_paused_note: No dose is expected during a pause, so those days are left out of the list above.
adherence_unmatched_note: Doses with no slot to sit in, either taken during a pause or beyond what the schedule expects.
regimen_schedule_hint: How often this episode expects a dose. Slots are counted from its start date, so editing this does not shift them.
regimen_schedule_amounts_hint: Optional. One amount keeps every slot the same size; add more to cycle through them in order, like an alternating 2 mg then 1 mg pattern.
regimen_pauses_hint: A range during which no dose is expected, so a break does not read as a run of missed doses.
regimen_pause_end_hint: Leave empty if the pause is still going.
regimen_stock_link_sub: How much is left, and when it's projected to run out
regimen_exposure_link_sub: Dose totals, days on each route, time on each regimen
stock_intro: How much is left of each drug, and when it's due to run out, both worked out from what you've logged.
stock_excluded_note: Doses left out of every projection above because more than one regimen was active and this app couldn't tell which drug they were: {count}.
stock_empty_body: Record how much you have of a drug, and this screen works out how long it will last from what you log.
stock_run_out_now: Already out, based on what you've logged
stock_run_out_unknown: Not enough dose data yet to project a run-out
stock_drug_placeholder: e.g. estradiol valerate or testosterone cypionate
exposure_intro: Totals from your dose log and regimen history. No target ranges, no comparisons.
exposure_dose_totals_empty: No doses logged in this range.
exposure_excluded_note: Doses left out of the totals above because more than one regimen was active and this app couldn't tell which drug they were: {count}.
exposure_route_days_empty: No regimen history in this range.
exposure_regimen_days_empty: No regimen history in this range.
side_effects_intro: What you notice, when you notice it. No grading and no advice.
side_effect_empty_body: Log a side effect when you notice one.
cycle_events_intro: Cycle days, charted against your regimen history. No prediction and no fertility framing.
cycle_event_empty_body: Log a cycle event when one happens, or a quiet month when nothing does.
cycle_event_range_required: Choose a start and end date to see the chart.
effects_timeline_sub: when you first noticed each change
effects_intro: Mark the day you first noticed each change. Where the literature gives a typical timing since your regimen began, it shows as a shaded band, from the table for your regimen's own hormone: the feminizing one for estradiol, the masculinizing one for testosterone. A change with no band is one the tables are quiet about.
effects_source: The shaded bands come from the Endocrine Society's 2017 clinical practice guideline (Hembree et al.) and GenderGP's HRT timeline tables, which cite WPATH Standards of Care v7. Every other effect below is named by the source noted underneath it, with no band: a guide naming a change is not the same claim as a guideline naming its timing.
effect_variability_notice: No evidence shows that age, body type, ethnicity or family appearance reliably predicts how someone responds to hormone therapy, with one likely exception: voice deepening in people on testosterone. The bands here describe the literature. They are not a schedule for your own body.
effects_no_regimen_body: This timeline anchors against the day your regimen began. Log a regimen episode first, and it'll pick it up from there.
effect_source_community: Named by the community guide That's Gender Dysphoria, FYI. No published timing, so no band.
effects_categories_intro: Turn a category off to remove its effects from this screen. Nothing already marked is affected.
effect_manage_types_intro: Add your own, or hide one you don't track. Hiding keeps everything already marked against it.
effect_type_new_placeholder: e.g. a feeling only you have a word for
effect_male_pattern_baldness_ceasing: Male pattern baldness ceasing to progress
effect_reduced_substance_tolerance_femin: Reduced tolerance of caffeine, alcohol or psychiatric medication
effect_genital_skin_texture_change_femin: Genital skin colour and texture changes
effect_increased_substance_tolerance_mas: Increased tolerance of caffeine, alcohol or psychiatric medication
effect_clear_hint: You can mark it again any time.
effect_window_bounded: The literature reports this usually starts {onsetMin} to {onsetMax} months in, with the full change typically in place by {compMin} to {compMax} months.
effect_window_no_completion: The literature reports this usually starts {onsetMin} to {onsetMax} months in; it doesn't say how long the change takes to finish.
effect_window_open_completion: The literature reports this usually starts {onsetMin} to {onsetMax} months in, and for some people keeps changing past {compMin} months.
hair_progress_sub: staging against a published scale, and fixed-position photos
hair_intro: Pick whichever published scale describes what you see, log a grade whenever you like, and take the same fixed-position photo every few weeks.
hair_unanchored_note: Weeks aren't being counted yet. Set the date you want to count from, or log a dose of anything you take and counting starts at the first one.
hair_anchor_from_dose: Counting from your first logged dose, {date}.
hair_anchor_sheet_hint: The day the weeks on this screen count from. Clear it and the first dose you logged takes over again.
hair_stage_empty_body: Pick the published scale that describes what you see, then log today's grade.
hair_scale_norwood_hamilton_sub: read off the hairline and the crown, twelve stages
hair_scale_sinclair_sub: read off the width of the central parting, five grades
hair_scale_other_sub: diffuse thinning, or a pattern neither scale describes
hair_scale_source: Source: two published classifications, Norwood-Hamilton and Sinclair (Sinclair et al., 2004). Neither is read against the other.
hair_other_placeholder: e.g. thinner all over the top
hair_photo_due_body: It's been a while since the last one. Taking one now keeps the interval even.
hair_photo_protocol_body: Use the same framing, lighting and distance each time, so what changes between photos is your hair and nothing else.
hair_photo_empty_body: Fixed-position photos land here as you take them, oldest first.
hair_removal_intro: Your electrolysis and laser sessions: what got treated, how it went, what it cost.
hair_removal_empty_body: Log a session when you have one. Area, method, pain and cost.
hair_removal_photo_hint: Save the session first, then attach photos to it.
hair_removal_photo_empty_body: Photos for this session land here as you add them.
ph_compare_reset: One selected photo is no longer available. Pick two anchors again.
ph_pick_two: Every photo in your journal, oldest first. Select two to compare.
ph_one_selected: One selected. Pick a second to compare.
ph_empty_body: Photos you attach to entries and milestones gather here, and one day “then vs now” will be worth it.
pj_read_failed_body: This is not the same as having no photos. Leave the screen and come back to try again.
vc_compare_reset: One selected recording is no longer available. Pick two anchors again.
vc_pick_two: Every recording in your journal, oldest first. Select two to compare.
vc_one_selected: One selected. Pick a second to compare.
vc_empty_body: Voice recordings you attach to entries gather here, so two moments can be heard side by side.
photo_heic: This looks like a HEIC photo, which this app can’t read yet. Convert it to JPEG first, or set your camera to save photos as JPEG.
photo_not_an_image: This file isn’t an image this app can read. Try a JPEG or PNG.
rem_web_body: Browsers cannot fire scheduled notifications reliably while the app is closed. Install the Android app to get medication and check-in reminders.
rem_web_note: Your data syncs nowhere, and an encrypted export is how it moves to the Android app safely.
checkin_sub: “How are you today?” · skipped on days you already logged
checkin_affirmations_sub: Adds a short affirming line to the check-in notification
affirmation_1: You know who you are better than anyone else does.
affirmation_2: Your gender is real, even on days it feels blurry.
affirmation_3: You don't owe anyone an explanation.
affirmation_5: There is no deadline on becoming yourself.
affirmation_6: Doubt is a visitor, not a verdict.
affirmation_8: However today looks, you are still you.
affirmation_9: The person you are becoming is worth the patience.
affirmation_10: You get to take up space.
affirmation_12: You have made it through every hard day so far.
affirmation_14: You deserve to be called by the right name.
rem_battery_body: Some phones (Xiaomi, Samsung, Huawei, OnePlus) kill background apps and silence alarms. If reminders stop arriving, allow the app to run in the background.
rem_alarm_note: Exact alarms survive reboots, but aggressive battery savers can silence them.
rem_capabilities_body: Android may block reminder delivery until notifications are allowed, and newer versions can still refuse exact alarms. Reminder and check-in channels live in system notification settings.
rem_hide_titles_sub: notifications show a generic title and message instead of a reminder's name

tl_empty_body: Add the days that matter and the shape of your own timeline appears.
home_anniv_years: {name}, {years} ago today. That day mattered. So does this one.
recap_custom_range_required: Pick both start and end days to read this custom range.
recap_open_range: An ongoing window, held in your own words.
compare_sub: put two ranges side by side
compare_empty: Pick a start and end day for each period to see them side by side.

tile_letter_sub: Shows when a time-capsule letter has become readable.
tile_letter_dismiss_hint: You have an unlocked letter waiting to be read.

notice_stock_out_body: Your supply of {drug} is estimated to have run out.

tile_hair_removal_guidance: Keep treated skin hydrated and protected from the sun.
tile_measurements_sub: Monthly prompt to record body measurements.

wrapped_off_body: Turn it on in Settings and finished weeks, months and years show up on Home.
wrapped_unknown_body: A wrapped covers a finished week, month or year. Open one from Home.
wrapped_month_intro: One month, as you logged it.
wrapped_year_intro: Twelve months, as you logged them.
wrapped_thin_title: Not much to look back on yet

wrapped_year_close: That was {year}, in your own words.

wrapped_share_none_selected: Pick something to make a card.
on_this_day_settings_sub: Look back on a good day from a month, six months or a year ago.
on_this_day_notify_sub: A notification when a good day resurfaces, independent of the card above.
on_this_day_notification_body: Open the app to look back on a good day.
on_this_day_off_body: Turn it on in Settings and a good day from the past can show up on Home again.
on_this_day_home_sub: A good day from your past
on_this_day_none_title: Nothing to look back on today
on_this_day_none_body: On this day only shows a good day from a month, six months or a year ago. None of today's three line up.
retro_notify_capabilities_body: Allow notifications to hear about wrapped and on-this-day. Their channels live in system notification settings.
tally_trend_sub: misgendering and correct gendering, over time
doubt_counterevidence_sub: Entries you tagged as euphoria, with high-euphoria body regions, or starred.
doubt_no_counterevidence_body: Tag an entry as euphoria or star it, and it will appear here ready when things feel heavy.
safe_space_hub_sub: A calm moment, past euphoria, and your own numbers.
safe_space_breathing_desc: Box breathing to help ground yourself.
safe_space_counterevidence_sub: Entries you tagged as euphoria, with high-euphoria body regions, or starred.
safe_space_letter_intro: A letter you sealed for yourself, now open.
safe_space_no_themes: No tagged moments in the pool yet.
tryout_row_sub: Track how something you're trying feels over time.
tryout_intro: A name, pronouns, a style, or anything else you're trying, and how it's felt so far.
tryout_label_placeholder_other: e.g. a short name for it
tryout_label_placeholder_presentation_st: e.g. first time to the shops
tryout_description_placeholder: Any detail that doesn't fit above
tryout_end_hint: Leave blank if there is no end date.
tryout_delete_hint: Its felt-sense history goes with it. This cannot be undone.
tryout_entries_none: No entries logged in this range yet.
tryout_entries_none_body: Entries logged while this tryout is open will show up here.
tryout_photo_empty_body: Photos for this tryout land here as you add them.

tryout_adopt_update_profile_name: Update profile name in app to "{name}"
letters_row_sub: Write a letter now, read it once the date arrives.
letters_intro: Write to your future self and pick a milestone or date to open it on. Nothing unlocks early, not even for you.
letters_empty_body: Write one above, and it will wait here until its unlock day.
letters_gone_body: It may have been deleted. The rest of your letters are on the letters screen.
streak_goal_row_sub: A gentle target, and a few quiet achievements
streak_goal_intro: Pick a target for how many days in a row you'd like to journal. A missed day doesn't erase what came before it, and backdating an entry into a gap repairs the streak exactly the way it does everywhere else in the app.
streak_goal_enable_sub: Off by default. Turn it on if a target is useful to you, not because it's expected.
streak_goal_gap_note: A gap here is just a gap. It's never treated as a broken streak.
streak_goal_achievements_intro: Reached once, kept for good - even after a gap in your entries.
journey_anchor_intro: There's no single correct place to start counting from: a diagnosis, a decision and a first step could all be day one, so pick whichever milestone you want durations, stats and wrapped measured from. Leaving it unset is just as complete an answer, and it changes nothing about a milestone's own countdown or anniversary.
journey_anchor_none_sub: Stats and wrapped simply leave out a combined duration, and every milestone still keeps its own date.
curve_sub: modelled or illustrative estradiol or testosterone between doses
curve_intro: What's known about estradiol and testosterone between doses: a fitted range where published data allows one, an illustrative shape where it doesn't. Your own results sit on top of either curve, and the curve is only context for reading them. No targets and no advice.
curve_band_note: The band is how uncertain the typical curve for an ester is, not how much people differ from one another. Your own numbers can fall outside it and still be ordinary.
curve_source: Model and parameters: estrannaise.js by alix, MIT licensed, estrannai.se. A three-compartment fit to published injection studies, with the uncertainty samples this band is drawn from.
curve_evidence_note: Some esters and routes have no curve here, on purpose. One is only drawn where the published research gives enough to draw it honestly, so a missing curve means the research falls short of that, not that your dose doesn't count.
curve_fit_hint: Moves each curve so it sits as close as it can to your own lab results. The published parameters and the illustrative shapes do not change.
curve_fit_applied: Fitted to your results. Points used: {count}. The band is multiplied by {factor}.
curve_fit_no_points: Nothing to fit to yet: this window holds no results for this hormone.
curve_fit_incomplete: Not fitted. The band is already drawing less than you took, so that gap is not yours to carry.
curve_volume_note: Injections logged by volume rather than milligrams, and left out of the band: {count}. Nothing records the concentration, so there is no dose to scale by.
curve_off_axis_note: Results left off the chart because their unit does not convert: {count}.
curve_empty_body: This screen draws estradiol injections on four esters as a fitted range, and an illustrative shape for estradiol's other routes and for testosterone by injection of cypionate or enanthate, by patch or by gel. Anything else has no research behind it good enough to draw from, which is this screen's limit and not something you have left undone.
curve_no_curve_note: Doses in this window that this screen draws nothing for: {count}. Their ester or route has no published study behind it good enough to draw from, so logging more of them will not produce a curve.
curve_chart_aria: Modelled range for {ester}, {from} to {to}. Your own results shown: {count}.
curve_sc_note: Injections under the skin drawn against intramuscular parameters: {count}. The published fits are all intramuscular, and this app has none for the subcutaneous route, so those doses are drawn on the assumption that the two behave alike.
curve_qual_notice: An illustrative shape, not a fitted estimate
curve_qual_note: This shape carries no measure of how closely real levels follow it: no study behind it says how much people vary. Your own numbers are what matter, not how they compare to the shape.
curve_qual_fit_applied: {drug}: fitted to your results. Points used: {count}. The shape is multiplied by {factor}.
curve_qual_fit_incomplete: {drug}: not fitted. The shape is already drawing less than you took, so that gap is not yours to carry.
curve_qual_fit_no_points: {drug}: nothing to fit to yet, because this window holds no results for it.
curve_qual_volume_note: Doses logged by volume or by count rather than milligrams, left out of the shape: {count}. Nothing records the strength, so there is no dose to scale by.
clinician_summary_row_sub: Doses, lab results and side effects for a chosen range, ready to print
clinician_summary_intro: Everything below comes from what you've already logged, for the range you pick. Nothing here is computed beyond that, and generating this doesn't save anything.
clinician_summary_range_required: Pick a start and end date to see the summary.
clinician_summary_regimen_episodes_empty: No regimen episodes in this range.
clinician_summary_doses_empty: No doses logged in this range.
clinician_summary_labs_empty: No lab results in this range.
clinician_summary_side_effects_empty: No side effects logged in this range.
clinician_summary_disclaimer: Self-reported logs, not clinical advice. No figure above is compared to a target range or interpreted.
clinician_summary_include_note: Choose which sections appear in the printed clinical dossier.
clinician_summary_cycle_events_empty: No cycle events logged in this range.
clinician_summary_empty_dossier: All sections are either excluded or have no records in this date range.
resources_row_sub: Trans organisations and helplines, kept in the app
resources_intro: Numbers and addresses worth having when there is no way to look them up. Nothing here is fetched, so this screen works with no signal.
resources_reviewed: Checked {date}. Hours change more often than numbers do.
resources_leaving: Tapping a number or an address leaves the app: the number goes to your phone, the address to your browser.
resources_pl_lambda: Anonymous support for LGBT+ people and the people around them. The same number books Lambda's free legal and psychological help.
resources_pl_transfuzja: Up to three free psychological consultations, legal help around transition, and support groups in several cities, open to non-binary people as well as trans people. Everything starts by email.
resources_pl_tranzycja: Transition in Poland step by step, with its own section on non-binary identity, and a list of Polish organisations that help, checked with them.
resources_int_translifeline: Peer support in the United States, staffed by trans people. A separate Canadian number is on the site.
resources_int_trevor: Crisis counselling for LGBTQ+ young people in the United States, by phone, text or chat.
resources_int_mindline_trans: Emotional support in the UK for trans, non-binary and gender fluid people, and for the people around them.
resources_int_gdb: A long read on the forms dysphoria takes and what transition involves. There is a Polish version on the site.
resources_int_transfemscience: Articles on feminising hormone therapy, heavy with citations and kept up to date.
resources_int_wpath_soc8: The internationally recognised clinical standard for trans and non-binary care, including low-dose and non-binary approaches to hormone therapy. Free to read, and backed by extensive citations.
resources_pl_zaimki: Gender neutral Polish: pronoun forms, neutral nouns, and a card to share the ones you use.
roadmap_row_sub: A step-by-step checklist, Polish for now
roadmap_intro: Four tracks, and you tick each one off separately. The order inside a track is how the procedure usually runs rather than a rule, and nothing here blocks anything else.
roadmap_not_advice: This describes what the procedure involves. It is not legal advice and none of it is about your particular case.
roadmap_caveat_pl: Poland has no gender recognition statute, so the procedure below follows from a Supreme Court resolution of 4 March 2025. Whether a mismatch between identity and the recorded sex is on its own enough to change it is still before that court (III CZP 20/26), so the outcome of a case is not a given.
roadmap_marker_note_pl: The marker itself only ever reads K or M. No procedure produces a third value.
roadmap_sources_pl: Put together from tranzycja.pl, Supreme Court announcements, the Ombudsman guide, and gov.pl.
roadmap_goal_pl_social_close_people: Family, or whoever you live with
roadmap_goal_pl_social_name_at_work: How you are addressed at work or school
roadmap_note_pl_social_name_at_work: None of this waits on a document or a court ruling.
roadmap_goal_pl_social_community: A support group, or a community
roadmap_goal_pl_presentational_clothes: Clothes you feel like yourself in
roadmap_note_pl_presentational_voice: On your own or with a speech therapist. Tied to neither the diagnosis nor hormones.
roadmap_note_pl_presentational_hair: Laser and electrolysis run as a series over months rather than one appointment.
roadmap_goal_pl_presentational_photo: A new photo for your documents
roadmap_note_pl_presentational_photo: Both the ID card and the passport need one.
roadmap_goal_pl_medical_two_specialists: Two specialists for the diagnosis: a doctor and a psychologist
roadmap_note_pl_medical_two_specialists: The PTS recommendations describe a psychiatrist or sexologist working with a psychologist. The clinical sexology certificate is rare, and the recommendations allow for its absence.
roadmap_note_pl_medical_psychologist: Usually several sessions, in practice anywhere from one visit to over a year. Psychological testing is increasingly skipped.
roadmap_goal_pl_medical_psych_opinion: A written opinion from the psychologist
roadmap_note_pl_medical_psych_opinion: The coded diagnosis is the core of it. The opinion may also cover how settled the identity is, the absence of contraindications, and capacity to give informed consent.
roadmap_goal_pl_medical_doctor_opinion: An opinion from a psychiatrist or sexologist
roadmap_note_pl_medical_doctor_opinion: Usually one visit and a short certificate: the diagnosis code, and a note that nothing contraindicates treatment.
roadmap_goal_pl_medical_diagnosis_code: The diagnosis code, in both opinions
roadmap_note_pl_medical_diagnosis_code: F64.0 under ICD-10 or HA60 under ICD-11. The two are treated as equivalent.
roadmap_note_pl_medical_diagnosis_code_c: F64.0's own criteria describe wanting to live as the opposite sex. It is issued in practice regardless of whether that fits.
roadmap_note_pl_medical_bloodwork: Blood count, lipid panel, liver and kidney tests, hormone levels. The therapy asks for these, the court does not.
roadmap_goal_pl_medical_keep_opinions: Originals, and copies for the court
roadmap_note_pl_medical_keep_opinions: The diagnosis can be spread out: the psychologist opinion for hormones, the doctor opinion later for the court.
roadmap_goal_pl_legal_birth_certificate: An abridged copy of your birth certificate from the USC
roadmap_note_pl_legal_which_court: It goes by where you live, not where you are registered. Big cities have several, split by district.
roadmap_goal_pl_legal_court_fee: The 100 zł fee to the court account
roadmap_note_pl_legal_court_fee: Paid before the application goes in, with the transfer confirmation attached to it. The amount follows from an analogy to the civil-records rules, so an individual court may assess it differently.
roadmap_goal_pl_legal_application: The application to change the sex marker on your birth certificate
roadmap_note_pl_legal_application: Since the Supreme Court resolution III CZP 6/24 of 4 March 2025 this is an application in non-contentious proceedings, not a lawsuit. Parents and children are no longer sued, and only a spouse can join as a participant.
roadmap_note_pl_legal_application_marker: It moves the marker between the two values named above. It does not create a third.
roadmap_goal_pl_legal_file_it: Filing it at the court desk, or by registered post
roadmap_note_pl_legal_file_it: The posting receipt stays with you as proof of the date.
roadmap_goal_pl_legal_formal_defects: Seven days to fix formal defects
roadmap_note_pl_legal_formal_defects: The deadline in the court summons runs from the day after you collect it and expires at 23:59 on the last day.
roadmap_goal_pl_legal_remote_hearing: Seven days to ask for a remote hearing
roadmap_note_pl_legal_remote_hearing: Counted from delivery of the notice of the hearing date.
roadmap_goal_pl_legal_closed_hearing: Asking for the hearing to be closed
roadmap_note_pl_legal_closed_hearing: The hearing is public until you ask for it not to be. You can also bring someone with you.
roadmap_goal_pl_legal_fee_waiver: A fee waiver, and its two seven-day deadlines
roadmap_note_pl_legal_fee_waiver: If it is refused, first ask for written reasons within seven days, then appeal within seven days of the reasoned decision reaching you. Another panel of the same court decides that appeal.
roadmap_goal_pl_legal_expert: If the court appoints an expert
roadmap_note_pl_legal_expert: The court picks the expert and the date itself. The opinion usually costs 500 to 2 000 zł and adds months to the case.
roadmap_goal_pl_legal_written_reasons: Seven days to ask for the reasons behind the ruling
roadmap_note_pl_legal_written_reasons: Without that request there is no appeal, and the ruling becomes final. The clock starts when the ruling is announced, or when it is served if the court decided in closed session.
roadmap_goal_pl_legal_appeal: Two weeks to appeal to the sąd okręgowy
roadmap_note_pl_legal_appeal: Counted from delivery of the ruling with its written reasons.
roadmap_goal_pl_legal_final_copy: A copy of the final ruling
roadmap_note_pl_legal_final_copy: It costs 20 zł and you can order it as many times as you need. A lot of offices will ask for one.
roadmap_goal_pl_legal_pesel: The annotation on the birth certificate, and a new PESEL
roadmap_note_pl_legal_pesel: The court sends the ruling to the USC where you were born. Expect to have to chase the new number; the official deadline is 30 days and it costs nothing.
roadmap_goal_pl_legal_new_birth_copy: A fresh copy of the birth certificate
roadmap_note_pl_legal_new_birth_copy: Copies ordered earlier still carry the old details.
roadmap_goal_pl_legal_name_usc: The USC decision changing your first name
roadmap_note_pl_legal_name_usc: Needed if the court ruling did not cover the name. The fee is 37 zł, and an appeal goes to the wojewoda.
roadmap_note_pl_legal_id_card: Apply at any gmina office. The old card is invalidated 120 days after the change is registered in the PESEL register.
roadmap_note_pl_legal_passport: The passport expires no later than 120 days after the change is registered, and is sometimes treated as void at once.
roadmap_note_pl_legal_driving_licence: The road traffic act gives 30 days to notify the starosta. The new licence is issued once the old one is handed back.
roadmap_goal_pl_legal_zus_ceidg: ZUS and CEIDG, within seven days
roadmap_note_pl_legal_zus_ceidg: An employer files the change of an insured person's details within seven days. If you run your own business, you update the CEIDG entry yourself, also within seven days.
roadmap_note_pl_legal_diplomas: A university issues a new diploma and a school a new certificate, once you show the ruling and hand the old document back.
roadmap_note_pl_legal_institutions: Each one handles it separately, off the new ID card and a copy of the ruling.
roadmap_goal_pl_legal_document_set: The set of documents to carry
roadmap_note_pl_legal_document_set: The new ID card, a copy of the final ruling, the USC name-change decision, and a fresh birth certificate copy.
roadmap_milestone_prompt_title: Add "{goal}" as a milestone on your timeline?
roadmap_milestone_sync_sub: Prompt to add ticked roadmap goals as timeline milestones
pj_leave_out_hint: Tap a photo to leave it out.
pj_collage_hint: One image, every photo in a grid, oldest first.
pj_timelapse_hint: A video, one photo at a time. It records as it plays, so making it takes as long as it runs.
pj_timelapse_unavailable: This browser can't record video, so a collage is the option here.
pj_stays_here: Nothing has left this device. The file is only in this screen until you share or save it.
pj_failed: That didn't work. Nothing was shared.
wear_log_intro: Wear time, live or filled in afterwards. No safe-maximum advice: a reminder is your own call.
wear_session_reminder_hint: Your own call. No built-in limit, no advice.
wear_session_empty_body: Log a session with a live timer, or fill one in afterwards.
appointment_prep_row_sub: Questions to bring to your next appointment
appointment_prep_intro: Anything you want to ask or remember at your next appointment. Tick it off once it's answered, or carry it forward.
appointment_prep_flag_hint: Flag anything you didn't get an answer to. It stays on the list and shows on the clinician summary.
appointment_prep_placeholder: What do you want to ask or remember?
appointment_prep_empty_body: Add a question or something to remember, and it'll be here for your next appointment.
appointment_prep_carry_aria: Carry {content} forward to the next visit
clinician_summary_appointment_prep_empty: Nothing on the appointment prep list.
surgery_journey_sub: procedures, dates and your own recovery log
surgery_intro: One record per procedure: the consults, the date, and whatever you want to keep track of while you heal. You can keep several going at once.
surgery_empty_body: Add a procedure when there is one to keep track of. Top surgery and facial surgery can sit here side by side.
surgery_delete_hint: Its consult dates, recovery notes, photos and checklist go with it. This cannot be undone.
surgery_notes_placeholder: Anything you want to remember about healing.
surgery_photos_empty: No photos yet. Ones you add land here by date.
surgery_checklist_empty: Nothing on the list. Write your own items as you think of them.
surgery_feelings_placeholder: How you feel today, healing observations, pain or rest notes...
surgery_wound_album_empty: No healing photos yet. Photos added here are encrypted privately.
surgery_milestone_prompt_body: Record today as a transition milestone in your timeline?
surgery_milestone_confirm_hint: This creates a permanent entry on your timeline marking this surgery day.
journaling_pause_row_sub: a declared break, quiet while it runs
journaling_pause_intro: Pausing tells the app you stepped away on purpose. Check-in and the streak line go quiet while it runs, and coming back never reads as a broken streak.
journaling_pause_running_hint: Check-in and the streak line stay quiet until you end the pause.
journaling_pause_end_hint: Leave empty if the pause is still going.
journal_book_row_sub: A print of a chosen range, to keep or to hand over
journal_book_intro: The print is made here on the device, and nothing is sent anywhere. It's something to keep or hand over, not a backup: a printed book can't be read back into the app. Restoring a journal still takes an archive file.
journal_book_range_required: Pick a start and end date to see the print.
journal_book_include_note: Only what you tick here is printed.
journal_book_empty: Nothing to print for this range.
editor_no_scales: No scales are ticked. A mood, tags, a note and a photo still make an entry.
dim_social_recognition_note: How far the people around you read your gender the way you feel it.
dim_gender_stability_note: Where the day sat between a steady sense of gender and a shifting one.
am_device_no_lock: Your device needs a screen lock before Android can bind the journal key to this phone. Set one first, or choose a PIN or passphrase now.
am_device_unavailable: This browser could not keep a device-bound journal key. Choose a journal passphrase instead.
am_setup_body: Everything you write is encrypted. This chooses what unlocks it, and you can change it later in Settings.
am_change_body: Changing this rewraps the same key, so it takes effect at once and nothing is re-encrypted whatever the size of your journal.
am_mode_device_sub_web: nothing to type, nothing to forget
am_mode_device_sub_android: the fingerprint, face or PIN you already use
am_mode_pin_sub: quick to type, and it does encrypt
am_mode_passphrase_sub: the strongest, and the only one that travels
am_device_detail_web: No passphrase to type and none to forget: the key stays in this browser profile. That cuts both ways. Anyone who copies this browser profile opens the journal without typing anything, and if the profile goes, so does the journal. Nothing you know can bring it back.
am_device_detail_android: Android keeps the key and hands it over once your screen lock says it is you, so there is nothing extra to type or remember. Removing the device screen lock destroys the key for good, and so does losing the phone. Nothing you know can bring it back.
am_passphrase_detail: The strongest of them all, and the only one that opens this journal on another device. At least {min} characters, and enGender has no account behind it: nobody, including this app, can recover a lost passphrase or the journal under it. Save it in a password manager now.
am_export_note: This mode ties the journal to this device, so an encrypted export is the only copy that would survive losing it.
am_setup_failed: That did not work. Try again, or pick another way.
am_changed_toast: Changed. Your journal opens that way from now on.
am_change_failed: Could not change it. Your journal still opens the way it did.
su_pin_body: Enter your PIN to open your journal.
su_passphrase_body: Enter your journal passphrase to carry on.
su_device_body: Confirm it is you to carry on.
su_device_key_gone: This browser no longer holds the key your PIN was bound to, so the PIN cannot open the journal any more.
pin_change_sub: the current one first, then the new one twice
am_pin_detail_web: Four digits, and this time they are the encryption key: the journal is wrapped under your PIN together with a key that never leaves this browser. A stolen copy of the journal file on its own cannot be attacked at all. A copy of this whole browser profile takes both halves, and then all 10,000 possible PINs fall in about five seconds on a fast graphics card. So a PIN stops a glance and a stray file, not somebody who can copy the whole profile. Choose a passphrase if that is who you are hiding from.
am_pin_detail_android: Four digits, and this time they are the encryption key: the journal is wrapped under your PIN together with a key that never leaves this phone. A stolen copy of the journal file on its own cannot be attacked at all. A copy of everything this app has stored on your phone takes both halves, and then all 10,000 possible PINs fall in about five seconds on a fast graphics card. So a PIN stops a glance and a stray file, not somebody who can copy everything the app holds. Choose a passphrase if that is who you are hiding from.
am_mode_biometric_sub: the fingerprint or face this device already asks for
am_biometric_detail: The key is wrapped under a secret this device only hands over once it has checked it is you, so there is nothing to type and nothing to remember. That secret never leaves the device and cannot be worked out from anything you know, so if the device goes, or the fingerprint or face it was set up with is removed, the journal goes with it. It is held in this browser profile too, so clearing that ends it the same way.
am_biometric_unavailable: This device would not release a secret for the journal. Choose a PIN or passphrase instead.
bm_unlock_body: Confirm it is you to open your journal.
bm_unlock_failed: This device did not confirm it was you, so the journal stayed shut.
bm_no_way_in: This device will not confirm it is you?
bm_forgot_key_note: The journal is encrypted with a key only this device unwraps. Nobody, including this app, can read it back without it.
